Replace the transfer call with sending funds to msg.sender instead of the provided receiver, altering who receives funds observed after sendTo.
Replace the transfer call with sending funds to owner (regardless of provided receiver), changing final balance recipients observed after sendTo.
Insert an additional transfer to owner after the original transfer, causing different balances after sendTo completes.
